summary: Client a at Depth and client b at Quote on one instrument: a five-level book reaches both, then a full packet with an empty level list and its totals: a gets a Depth frame without depth, b its Quote frame, both with the packet's totals.

notes: The second packet sends MarketDepthDTOList with no levels in it but carries totalBuyQuantity and totalSellQuantity. Both sides publish its Depth frame without a depth key and with the packet's totals (never the cached book or the book's totals), and its Quote frame as for any full packet. Live check: does HDFC's empty book list mean unchanged or cleared (lead ruling 2026-11-09).

deviations.reason: HDFC Securities sends lastTradeTime in epoch seconds (the web's own test pairs lastTradeTime 1700000000 with packetTimestamp 1700000000000); the web sends it unconverted as ltt, a docs key that is epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop converts it to ms (investright::trade_time_ms). Lead decision: ltt in seconds -> ms, web defect (wrong unit).

A cash equity's packet carries no OI (proto3 writes oi 0); the web sends that 0 as oi and open_interest instead of leaving them out (web openalgo#2376). The desktop counts OI on the derivative segments only. Lead decision: web zeros for values the stream did not send are left out, web defect.

The web's server also sends this client a richer mode's publication of the instrument, beyond the modes it holds; the desktop sends one frame per held mode.
